body.input: Which companies opened an office in the UK in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, the following companies opened (or announced the opening of) an office in the UK in 2026:

1. **Rillet** — The San Francisco-based agentic ERP platform opened a new office in central London (announced November 2026), citing that UK and European customers already drive 10% of its net new ARR. The company plans significant hiring in London.

2. **Planet Labs** — The Earth-observation and satellite data company opened its first UK office in central London (announced July 2026). The office serves as a hub for AI and analytics partnerships, with UK Space Minister Liz Lloyd calling it "a powerful vote of confidence in the UK's world-leading science and technology ecosystem."

3. **DXC Technology** — Opened a new office in Farnborough, UK (announced June 2026), including the launch of an Aerospace and Defense Hub. DXC already employs more than 6,500 people in the UK.

These are the 2026-dated UK office openings identified from recent announcements. There may be additional openings not captured here.

Planet Labs announced the opening of its first UK office in central London in July 2026, establishing a hub for AI and analytics partnerships.
DXC Technology announced the opening of a new office in Farnborough, UK, in June 2026, including the launch of an Aerospace and Defense Hub.

# Rillet opens London office as European demand grows

Agentic ERP platform says UK and European customers already drive 10% of its net new ARR, and it plans significant hiring in the months ahead

Share:

Listen to article

Investment

Rillet, an agentic ERP (enterprise resource planning) platform for finance teams, has announced its expansion into the UK with a new office in central London.

The San Francisco company said its UK team is already on the ground.

Rillet said customers in the UK and across Europe already drive 10% of its net new ARR.

Those customers include Black Forest Labs, Temporal and Primer, which Rillet describes as some of the fastest-growing AI companies. [...] The company said its international net new ARR more than tripled month over month.

Rillet said UK companies were choosing it long before it had a local presence, which drove its decision to expand into Europe.

The expansion comes less than three months after Rillet raised a $100 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation, led by ICONIQ with participation from Sequoia and Andreessen Horowitz.

Rillet said it now serves nearly 1,000 customers across 75 countries.

It said it is building a large-scale organisation in London, with its founding UK team in place and significant hiring planned in the months ahead.

Nicolas Kopp, CEO and founder of Rillet, said: “Within a year of launching in the US, we already had finance teams in the UK running on Rillet.” [...] He added: “Those teams are building some of Europe’s most ambitious companies, and they deserve a finance partner that keeps up with them. Finance leaders want to know the people behind their systems are close by and committed to them, and a London team lets us be exactly that.”

Dave Arkell, CFO at Black Forest Labs, said: “We chose Rillet for our ERP because they matched that ambition.”

Rillet said London is a natural starting point because the city brings together a deep pool of finance and accounting talent and an established professional services ecosystem.

The company said the move is also a return to familiar ground for Kopp, who studied accounting at the London School of Economics and spent several years working in the City.
